description: This file manages shared interrupt service routines (ISRs) in a Zephyr-based embedded system, including installation, removal, and handling of shared IRQs with dynamic support.

methods.name: z_shared_isr
methods.description: Handles shared interrupt by invoking all registered client ISRs.

methods.name: z_isr_install
methods.description: Installs a new ISR for a given IRQ, supporting shared IRQs with multiple clients.

methods.name: swap_client_data
methods.description: Swaps data between two ISR table entries.

methods.name: shared_irq_remove_client
methods.description: Removes a client from a shared IRQ entry and unshares if only one client remains.

methods.name: arch_irq_disconnect_dynamic
methods.description: Weakly defined function to disconnect a dynamic IRQ, calls z_isr_uninstall.

methods.name: z_isr_uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls an ISR from a given IRQ, handling shared IRQs and cleanup.
